claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Pyrazinamide is a prodrug activated by mycobacterial pyrazinamidase and has no meaningful activity against human cancer cells at 2.5 uM; any apparent effect would be nonspecific, so it is expected to be largely inactive.

raw.cytotoxic_mechanism: Pyrazinamide is a prodrug activated by mycobacterial pyrazinamidase and has no meaningful activity against human cancer cells at 2.5 uM; any apparent effect would be nonspecific, so it is expected to be largely inactive.
